notes: v0.3.85: Reconnect fixed at the root. STUN no longer mistakes the other peer's still-flowing audio for the STUN reply, so you can disconnect and rejoin without 'all STUN servers failed' (no PC restart needed). Video clip saving after toggling video off then on is fixed: the rolling-WAV lifecycle is race-proofed, a recorder thread/handle leak that orphaned .jamsync_rolling_*.wav files is fixed, and ffmpeg producing an empty clip now errors instead of faking success. Any remaining clip failure shows a specific on-screen reason instead of failing silently.
